words.ex: The disease causes a {{BLANK}} loss of memory over many years.

words.ex: Your summary should cover only the {{BLANK}} points of the lecture.

words.ex: A living language is never {{BLANK}}; it changes with every generation.

words.ex: The state passed {{BLANK}} regulations on factory pollution.

words.ex: Many native people {{BLANK}}ed to diseases brought from Europe.
words.tr: 많은 원주민이 유럽에서 들어온 병에 쓰러졌어.

words.ex: Ribosomes are the sites of protein {{BLANK}} in a cell.

words.ex: Desert plants have a high {{BLANK}} for heat and dry soil.

words.ex: Rice farmers grow seedlings first and then {{BLANK}} them to flooded fields.

words.ex: Mental {{BLANK}} makes drivers slower to react to danger.

words.ex: A nerve cell fires only when the signal reaches a certain {{BLANK}}.

name: 미술·건축 / 음악·문학·연극 외 / 교육·캠퍼스 생활 / 연구·논증 외

words.ex: She spent four years on her doctoral {{BLANK}} about coral reefs.

words.ex: Repeating the experiment three times improved the {{BLANK}} of our data.

words.ex: After two research jobs, graduate school was a natural {{BLANK}}.
